objective: Gate2 tecnico READ_ONLY de Tablajeria. Mapear arquitectura tecnica exacta antes de cualquier mutation: archivos, rutas, endpoints, servicios, entidades SQL canonicas, contratos de datos, riesgos, pruebas y plan quirurgico posterior. No construir. No publicar mutation. No tocar Produccion. No modificar backend ni frontend.

context.functional_domain: Tablajeria convierte un insumo base comprado o existente en inventario en multiples derivados, cortes, subproductos, merma y desperdicio, con trazabilidad, afectacion de inventario y prorrateo de costos.

technical_scope_to_map: frontend pages and routes for Operaciones and Tablajeria
backend routers and endpoints related to Operaciones, Inventarios, Productos, Costos, Compras and RBAC
services and repositories that can be reused without duplication
SQL Server canonical entities for products, inventory, movements, costs, purchases, suppliers, companies, business units, warehouses, users, roles and audit
data contract for plantilla, orden, ejecucion, insumo base, derivados, merma, subproductos and prorrateo
mutation candidates for a later surgical gate
test plan for backend, frontend, SQL read-only safety and regression
questions_to_answer: What exact frontend files currently implement or reference Tablajeria
What exact frontend files currently implement Operaciones menu integration

queries.name: gate2_tablajeria_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (500) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc, o.create_date, o.modify_date FROM sys.objects o WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaje%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%plantilla%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rendimiento%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%merma%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%subproducto%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: gate2_canonical_inventory_product_cost_purchase_objects
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (800) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%empresa%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%sucursal%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%almacén%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%insumo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%movimiento%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%kardex%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%margen%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%receta%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%contab%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%auditoria%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%workflow%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: gate2_canonical_identity_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (800) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, c.name AS column_name, t.name AS data_type, c.max_length, c.precision, c.scale, c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON c.object_id = o.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types t ON c.user_type_id = t.user_type_id WHERE LOWER(c.name) IN ('empresaid','unidadnegocioid','serverid','sucursalid','almacenid','productoid','insumoid','proveedorid','usuarioid') OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%fechaoperacion%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%lote%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%cantidad%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%peso%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%merma%' OR LOWER(c.name) LIKE '%rendimiento%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name, c.column_id

queries.name: gate2_foreign_keys_for_reuse
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (500) fk.name AS fk_name, SCHEMA_NAME(parent_o.schema_id) AS parent_schema, parent_o.name AS parent_object, SCHEMA_NAME(ref_o.schema_id) AS referenced_schema, ref_o.name AS referenced_object FROM sys.foreign_keys fk INNER JOIN sys.objects parent_o ON fk.parent_object_id = parent_o.object_id INNER JOIN sys.objects ref_o ON fk.referenced_object_id = ref_o.object_id WHERE LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%movimiento%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(parent_o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%almacen%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%empresa%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%unidad%' OR LOWER(ref_o.name) LIKE '%usuario%' ORDER BY parent_schema, parent_object, fk_name

queries.name: gate2_indexes_for_reuse_and_traceability
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (500) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, i.name AS index_name, i.type_desc, i.is_unique, i.is_primary_key FROM sys.indexes i INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON i.object_id = o.object_id WHERE i.name IS NOT NULL AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%movimiento%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%lote%') ORDER BY schema_name, object_name, index_name

queries.name: gate2_sql_modules_references
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (500) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o LEFT JOIN sys.sql_modules m ON o.object_id = m.object_id WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%operacion%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%operaciones%' OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%fechaoperacion%' OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%empresaid%' OR LOWER(m.definition) LIKE '%unidadnegocioid%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: gate2_rbac_permissions_and_menu
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (500) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS object_name, o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%permiso%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rol%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%rbac%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%modulo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%menu%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%usuario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%autoriz%' ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: gate2_table_row_estimates
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (500) SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name, o.name AS table_name, SUM(p.rows) AS estimated_rows FROM sys.objects o INNER JOIN sys.partitions p ON o.object_id = p.object_id WHERE o.type = 'U' AND p.index_id IN (0,1) AND (LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%tablaj%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%producto%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%inventario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%movimiento%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%costo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%compra%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%proveedor%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%usuario%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%modulo%' OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%permiso%') GROUP BY SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id), o.name ORDER BY schema_name, table_name

success_criteria: Mapa tecnico V1 claro y auditable
Entidades canonicas SQL identificadas para reutilizacion
Sin duplicacion de catalogos o tablas
Gate3 permitido solo si no hay blockers
blocking_criteria: Riesgo de duplicar catalogos o tablas canonicas
Riesgo de romper Operaciones o Inventarios
